title: Colorado PUC Decision R26-0063-I: Interim Decision Rescinding Recommended Decision No. R26-0055
summary: Interim Decision Rescinding Recommended Decision No. R26-0055
text:
Decision No. R26-0063-I 
BEFORE THE PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION OF THE STATE OF COLORADO 
PROCEEDING NO. 25A-0194E 
IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF PUBLIC SERVICE COMPANY OF 
COLORADO FOR APPROVAL OF ITS 2026-2027 RENEWABLE ENERGY COMPLIANCE 
PLAN, DISPATCHABLE DISTRIBUTED GENERATION PROCUREMENT PROPOSAL, 
AND CORRESPONDING MODIFICATIONS TO ITS RENEWABLE ENERGY STANDARD 
ADJUSTMENT AND ELECTRIC COMMODITY ADJUSTMENT COST RECOVERY 
MECHANISMS. 
INTERIM DECISION RESCINDING RECOMMENDED 
DECISION NO. R26-0055 
Issued Date: January 28, 2026 
I. 
STATEMENT, SUMMARY, FINDINGS AND CONCLUSIONS 
1. 
Decision No. R26-0055 issued on January 27, 2026. 
2. 
The Recommended Decision is not yet a decision of the Colorado Public Utilities 
Commission (“Commission”), no party has filed any exception, and the Commission has taken no 
action on the Recommended Decision. 
3. 
The undersigned rescinds the recommendation and Recommended Decision No. 
R26-0055 will have no effect. 
4. 
A separate Recommended Decision will be issued with more specific 
recommendations regarding rulings on pending requested relief. 
II. 
ORDER 
A. 
It is Ordered That: 
1. 
Recommended Decision No. R26-0055 issued on January 27, 2026 is rescinded and 
is of no effect.
